attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter gosaikunda-temple
load car1 adult 1
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple myagang-shelter
unload car1 adult 1
unload car1 elderly 2
drive car1 myagang-shelter suryagadhi-market
load car1 injured 3
drive car1 suryagadhi-market myagang-shelter
unload car1 injured 3
</plan>
COST: 154

Everyone is rescued, so no one is deferred. The plan uses two round trips from Myagang shelter: 51 minutes each way to Gosaikunda temple, and 26 minutes each way to Suryagadhi market. I avoided the Dhunche farm to Gosaikunda temple road because of the fast floodwater, and I did not use Gosaikunda temple as a drop-off point because it is not designated for evacuees.
